description: This file contains functions and types for rendering and chunking Markdown IR (Intermediate Representation), including splitting, merging, and limiting rendered content size.

methods.name: renderMarkdownIRChunksWithinLimit
methods.description: Main function to split Markdown IR into chunks within a size limit, rendering each chunk.

methods.name: splitMarkdownIRByRenderedLimit
methods.description: Splits a Markdown IR chunk into smaller chunks based on rendered size limit.

methods.name: findLargestChunkTextLengthWithinRenderedLimit
methods.description: Finds the maximum text length of a chunk that fits within the rendered size limit.

methods.name: findMarkdownIRPreservedSplitIndex
methods.description: Finds a suitable split index in text, preserving whitespace and parentheses.

methods.name: splitMarkdownIRPreserveWhitespace
methods.description: Splits a Markdown IR into smaller chunks, preserving whitespace boundaries.

methods.name: mergeAdjacentStyleSpans
methods.description: Merges adjacent style spans with the same style.

methods.name: mergeAdjacentLinkSpans
methods.description: Merges adjacent link spans with the same href.

methods.name: mergeMarkdownIRChunks
methods.description: Merges two Markdown IR chunks into one.

methods.name: coalesceWhitespaceOnlyMarkdownIRChunks
methods.description: Coalesces whitespace-only chunks with neighboring chunks if rendering size permits.
